home.title: Money that moves when you speak
home.body: Kawase is an AI money app for everything on Arc. Ask in your own language, by voice or by text: it proposes, you approve, and the chain enforces your limits.

gettingStarted.body: Open the web app as a guest in seconds, or install it on iPhone or Android.
